definitions.explanation: A group, organization, or opinion breaking apart into opposing factions. Implies conflict or disagreement.
The splitting of cells or atomic nuclei in scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {政党|せいとう}が{分裂|ぶんれつ}した。
{意見|いけん}の{対立|たいりつ}でチームが{分裂|ぶんれつ}した。
examples.english: The team split apart due to conflicting opinions.

examples.japanese: {党内|とうない}の{分裂|ぶんれつ}が{深|ふか}まり、{選挙|せんきょ}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The internal party split deepened and had a major impact on the election.

examples.japanese: {細胞|さいぼう}が{分裂|ぶんれつ}する。
がん{細胞|さいぼう}は{通常|つうじょう}の{細胞|さいぼう}より{速|はや}く{分裂|ぶんれつ}する。
examples.english: Cancer cells divide faster than normal cells.

examples.japanese: {核|かく}{分裂|ぶんれつ}によって{莫大|ばくだい}なエネルギーが{放出|ほうしゅつ}される。
examples.english: Enormous energy is released through nuclear fission.

notes:
Compound of {分|ぶん} (to divide) + {裂|れつ} (to tear, to rip). Carries a stronger, more negative connotation than {分割|ぶんかつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{分裂|ぶんれつ}する (to split, to divide)
・{政党|せいとう}の{分裂|ぶんれつ} (party split)
・{細胞|さいぼう}{分裂|ぶんれつ} (cell division)
・{核|かく}{分裂|ぶんれつ} (nuclear fission)
・{分裂|ぶんれつ}{状態|じょうたい} (state of division)
・{国|くに}の{分裂|ぶんれつ} (national division)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{分裂|ぶんれつ}: splitting apart with conflict or natural force; often negative
・{分割|ぶんかつ}: deliberate, controlled division into parts
・{分離|ぶんり}: separation of connected elements; more neutral
